reviews.title: Exceeds expectations!
reviews.comment: This monitor is pretty good for what it is. I've had higher end brands of monitors in the past, and while it does take a little longer for it to detect video signal. It has very good picture quality for the price and having HDR and capable of 180Hz is a huge bonus! One thing to keep in mind before purchasing this monitor: the pedestal is non-adjustable so if you're not planning on putting it on a wall-mount, make sure either your chair, desk, or both are height adjustable. The monitor is surprisingly very lightweight for it's size and has a sleek design. This product checks off all 3 key points of a good product: STYLISH, AFFORDABLE, FUNCTIONAL.
